name: FFmpeg Smart Profiles
description: Installs FFmpeg Smart stream/output profiles and manages hardware capacity cache rebuilds.
author: matrix2669

fields.label: Stream Profile 1 options
fields.help_text: Optional ffmpeg-smart flags, for example: -vc h264 -maxres 1080 -maxbr 8M -maxchan 2

fields.label: Remove disabled or renamed managed profiles
Update existing managed profiles
fields.help_text: Only profiles already pointing to ffmpeg-smart.sh or matching this plugin's native FFmpeg templates are updated.

fields.label: Output profile behavior
fields.description: All managed Stream and Output Profiles use the bundled ffmpeg-smart.sh. Output Profiles use its pipe-safe input mode.

actions.label: Install or Update Profiles
actions.description: Create the selected Stream Profile and Output Profiles.

actions.label: Rebuild Hardware Cache
actions.description: Run FFmpeg Smart hardware capability and real-concurrency benchmarks in the background.

confirm.title: Rebuild hardware cache?
confirm.message: This stops active FFmpeg Smart transcodes, blocks new ones until the benchmark finishes, and places a heavy concurrent load on every visible GPU. Proxy-only streams continue running. Runtime is approximately 1–2 minutes for one GPU and 2–4 minutes per GPU when multiple GPUs are detected; the enabled plugin shows a detected-GPU estimate.

actions.label: Benchmark Status
actions.description: Show benchmark state and recent log output.

actions.label: Remove Managed Profiles
actions.description: Remove only unlocked profiles matching this plugin's managed definitions.

confirm.title: Remove managed profiles?
confirm.message: Channels using these profiles may need to be reassigned first.
